# Changelog

Repository-level changelog aggregating every per-contract `customProperties.changelog` entry across the canonical surface under `references/odcs/pc/`.

Entries are grouped by canonical-version **wave** (`MAJOR.MINOR.x`), newest wave first. Within a wave, rows are sorted by version descending and then contract id ascending. The wave grouping mirrors how each canonical hardening / Fabric milestone shipped: see `planning-mds/STATUS.md` and `planning-mds/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` for the milestone-by-milestone breakdown.

## How to read this file

- **Wave** — the canonical-version family the entry belongs to (`0.4.x`, `0.3.x`, `0.2.x`, `0.1.x`). Each wave corresponds to a milestone or hardening phase. The 0.1.x wave is the original ship state for each contract; 0.2.0 is the W015 cross-cutting ADR refactor; 0.3.0 is the C3 bulk hardening refactor; 0.4.0 is the C4 entity-gap closure; 0.4.1 / 0.4.2 are the C5 / C7 single-contract cleanups.
- **Date** — when the entry was authored, when the per-contract changelog string carries an `(author, YYYY-MM-DD)` parenthetical. Older entries omit the date; the column shows `—` in that case.
- **Summary** — the per-contract changelog text verbatim, with the leading `<version>:` token stripped and any trailing `(author, date)` parenthetical lifted into the **Date** column.

Versioning rules: `references/design-decisions/pc/versioning-policy.md`. Status promotion gates: `references/design-decisions/pc/status-promotion.md`.
